subject: Help: after shiny update I stopped seeing absolute panel

messages.author: 8fac9aa09c00237d
messages.subject: Help: after shiny update I stopped seeing absolute panel
parts:
Hi all,

Can someone have an idea why after updating shiny to R version 3.1.2 I stopped seeing the absolute panel in shinny apps built located in my computer. As an example, if I run shiny superzip example on a webpage (shiny home page or on shinnyapps) I can see the absolute panel, but in my own computer not. Do I have to update some kind of software? And this only happen after I updated shiny.

Thanks in advanced
Jorge

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Help: after shiny update I stopped seeing absolute panel
parts:
Hi Jorge -

There's a slight change that's necessary for the new version of Shiny. For the absolutePanel, instead of class="modal modal-body", you need class="modal-body". This is because, in Bootstrap 3 elements with class="modal" are hidden (they have display:none set in CSS).

-Winston

messages.subject: Re: Help: after shiny update I stopped seeing absolute panel
parts:
Actually better yet, change "modal modal-body" to "panel panel-default"--this will give about the same visual effect (rounded corners and a subtle shadow).

I've now updated the superzip example for Shiny 0.11. Thanks for letting us know about this!

https://github.com/jcheng5/superzip
